summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a clinical-stage biotech company, filed a Form 6-K on July 7, 2026, reporting a press release about a successful formulation feasibility study for intranasal delivery of its proprietary MEAI compound, initially for alcohol use disorder. The filing describes positive results showing MEAI can be incorporated into a stable, soluble solution for intranasal administration. No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a routine update on product development progress. There are no deal terms, as this is not a transaction. What to watch: any future clinical trial results or regulatory milestones.
